lines.en-US: A falling metal pole pierced through you

lines.japanese: ワザとらしい陽炎が「夢じゃないぞ」って嗤ってる

lines.en-US: The heat haze was sneering at me, reminding me that it wasn't a dream

lines.zh-CN: 眩晕模糊的视野中你的侧脸，隐约仿佛在微微微笑

lines.en-US: Through my darkening eyes, I thought I saw you smile

lines.japanese: 何度世界が眩んでも陽炎が嗤って奪い去る。

lines.en-US: The sneering heat haze plunders away one darkened world after another

lines.japanese: 繰り返して何十年。もうとっくに気が付いていたろ。

segments.text: 繰り返して何十年。もうとっくに気が付いていたろ。

lines.en-US: The color of my splashed blood reflected off your eyes and your robotic body

lines.en-US: I laughed at the seemingly annoyed heat haze, as though saying "Take that!"

lines.en-US: Said, "It didn't work again."
